name: TEACh
summary: 对话驱动的具身任务数据集，包含人类指挥者与执行者的语言和动作轨迹。
summaryEn: A dialogue-driven embodied-task dataset with language and action trajectories from human commander-follower interactions.
organizations: Allen Institute for AI and collaborators
organizationsZh: 艾伦人工智能研究所及合作团队
wmNote: 适合部分可观测条件下的交互规划。
wmNoteEn: Supports interactive planning under partial observability.

evidence.sourceTitle: [2110.00534] TEACh: Task-driven Embodied Agents that Chat
evidence.statement: Recorded dialogues accompany a follower navigating and manipulating household environments, establishing interaction episodes rather than text-only conversations.
